name: Edge Growth Marching Cubes
aliases: Marching Cube Algorithm Based on Edge Growth
definition: A surface rendering algorithm that solves MC ambiguity and empty voxel waste by extracting seed triangles, then growing the iso-surface into adjacent cubes via common edges (growth edges) using a queue, rather than processing all voxels independently.
summary: Edge Growth Marching Cubes is a surface extraction algorithm that resolves topological ambiguities by growing a connected manifold from seed triangles rather than processing voxels independently.
